name: Paxos
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Stablecoin issuer Paxos admitted in a statement that the account that paid out nearly 20 BTC in fees in a single transaction in the early hours of September 11 belonged to the company. Paxos claims that end users have not been affected and all user funds are safe. The announcement comes after users on twitter speculated that PayPal could be responsible for the transaction, as analytics platform OXT identified relevant wallet accounts belonging to PayPal. A Paxos spokesperson said: "PayPal takes no responsibility for this as this error was caused by Paxos itself.
